doctrine:
Work and commit only in C:/Users/jeffm/overgo_audiocpp2 on codex/overgo_audiocpp2. Base: master 39934bd80daa20e19740df6ed7c47cbca166d856; initial audio plan: 3adcb14fb73f33454297338c685c6876879e2e61. Bootstrap 511e1ce3 established lane audio2. Keep only audio-owned work; omit foreign rows without completion credit. Do not push, modify source worktrees, merge additional master changes without a new request, or interfere with foreign processes. Honor operator stops.

Follow skill.md and the existing plan, claim, verification and commit owners. Keep one live plan in docs/plan.json; the gate alone commits and advances it. Renew claims after contract changes. Use the worktree's own live supervisor when configured. Preserve all pending identities and acceptance commands, including retained receipt rows; retire covered members only through the completion owner. Reuse valid source-bound results where the existing verifier permits it, never fabricate receipts or weaken required checks. Historical execution detail belongs in retained evidence and Git rather than dispatch instructions.

Priority: finish the current CPU baseline, shared synthesis training/publication and full-encoder ASR training before broader voice or generative-audio work. CPU routing, recovery and artifact preparation may proceed independently when eligible. Prove current audio consumers before resident execution or general kernel tuning. Extend existing speechsynth, speechrecognition, audiodsp, media, modelrecipe, trainingprogram, trainingworkflow, evaluation and serving owners. No second trainer, audio gate, graph engine, scheduler or lifecycle; model-family facts belong in artifacts and recipes, not executor branches.

Use current available RAM, system commit capacity, CPU capacity, device capacity and reservations at admission; installed capacity and another process's identity are not resource budgets. Compare the admitted process tree's declared and measured requirements with available capacity. Start with serial model-test groups under contention, retaining the minimum parallelism required by explicit concurrency assertions; a reference model's 4 GiB numeric ceiling is not a process cap or peak claim. Do not impose that model-specific Go heap target on unrelated gate suites; admit their actual aggregate resource requirements. Keep a bounded timeout per group and release process state between groups. Put model-test concurrency in each command; do not globally serialize unrelated gate suites, whose parallel subtests otherwise queue behind other parents. Recheck before each expensive group; resume as soon as capacity permits, without requiring another worktree to stop or an operator to grant a fixed window. If no supported execution fits, retain the exact unfinished check and continue eligible low-resource work. CPU checks hold no GPU reservation. Device correctness may share admitted capacity; matched performance measurements require isolation.

Use a pinned behavioral oracle, never a linked runtime. Preserve source commits, licenses, exact model/corpus/transform identities and immutable input artifacts. Keep all new outputs in audio2. Re-establish prerequisites missing from this base, including the old retained MLP cache where a real consumer needs it; do not restore test-only wrappers wholesale. Preserve Granite Speech 5.0 TurboCTC, native Safetensors Nemotron 3.5 ASR and FireRedVAD references; reject the incompatible Q8 GGUF. Keep silent AMI material quarantined until provenance is proved.

CPU is numerical authority. Require real gradients and updates, tied/frozen ownership, exact stop and resume of weights, optimizer, scheduler, RNG and data stream, and pre/post WER with denominators. Final-feature adapter training does not establish full-encoder, recurrent or audio-conditioned training. Never use reference text as prediction input. Preserve distinct GeneratedAudio, AudioReference and transcript contracts; synthesis silence is valid where ASR silence is refused. Require bounded waveform/session behavior, authentication, cancellation, model attribution and restart recovery; frame offsets do not establish word timestamps.

Implement related group members together; run focused development checks and dependency-derived integration at coherent boundaries. Missing tests named in the plan remain implementation obligations; skipped, unavailable and zero-match execution never pass. Broader training or CUDA work must serve an identified production consumer. Profile complete sequences before isolated operators; derive geometry and workspace from declarations. Compare identical artifacts, inputs, precision and quality policy, reporting cold/warm wall, transfers, synchronization, layout and actual peak availability separately. Unknown metrics and fewer transfers do not prove a speedup. Preserve failed and no-gain outcomes. Declare necessary production growth through the budget owner and remove displaced implementation.

Retain the suite-scheduling observation from preparation evidence:sha256:2c9f7201842ca9e39fb4ffa933c16c261cb2d586c62a300d7d5d93cd2935553d: global -parallel=1 led to a parent active-time timeout while parallel children waited; TestLaneServerEndsWithRun passed alone in 0.547s. Remove the blanket override and constrain only memory-heavy model commands. Any future deadline-accounting change must distinguish blocked child scheduling from a genuinely stalled parent without extending budgets or allowing subtest chatter to hide a stall.
